scope: Full static source/test read; compiler-only measurement separately authorized; no candidate execution

provider_tests.coverage: Shell greps and byte limit only; no compilation, API behavior, CLI failure receipts, FD lifecycle, synchronization or cleanup controls

findings.observed: All paths emit key=value lines via printf/KV2/KVL, rather than required JSON.
findings.required: One parseable terminal JSON receipt with documented status and exit mapping.

findings.observed: stop calls exit(1) on every status, including NOT_CHECKED; FAIL1 is also used as a status string.
findings.required: Preserve required status enum and NOT_CHECKED exit2; distinguish unavailable prerequisites from attempted runtime errors.

findings.observed: cleanup ignores all release and close results, yet receipts declare cleanup_unknown=false; no verified GPU quiescence exists after fence timeout.
findings.required: Checked cleanup before terminal receipt; actual uncertainty/error propagation; never claim resources safely drained without evidence.

findings.observed: Source omits context/alignment/device-array arguments in multiple Level Zero calls; uses ZE_COMMAND_QUEUE_GROUP_COPY_BIT and COMPUTE_BIT instead of the header PROPERTY_FLAG names; uses ifd.type although actual import descriptor field is flags.
findings.required: Compile exact candidate against pinned official headers; bind actual diagnostics before repair.

findings.observed: cuCtxCreate call has three arguments; CUDA13.4 macro-selected signature requires actual compiler adjudication.
findings.required: Use the exact pinned CUDA ABI, without silently substituting older headers.

findings.observed: import_fd is set to -1 after successful zeMemAllocDevice, assuming importer consumes the application duplicate.
findings.required: Verify actual import FD ownership contract and retain/close only application-owned descriptors at the documented point; unknown ownership is an unresolved gate.

findings.observed: CUDA context/allocation/export occurs before Intel device/import eligibility is known; CUDA context also precedes the DMA_BUF capability gate.
findings.required: Check prerequisite identities/capabilities before allocation where possible; unsupported current WSL export capability must yield an honest unavailable outcome.

findings.observed: Enumeration counts are unbounded and some query errors are silently skipped; Intel root device type and imported allocation owner handle are not validated.
findings.required: Bound enumeration and report actual query errors; bind full UUID/PCI, GPU/root status and allocation owner to the intended physical devices.

findings.observed: The fixture labels direct_transport_qualified=false, which is an appropriate limited claim.
findings.required: Preserve that limit even after successful payload tests; API DEVICE labels and byte parity do not establish direct VRAM transport.

current_hardware_limit: Local NVIDIA plus AMD shared iGPU; no Intel target. Actual WSL CUDA attribute query reported DMA_BUF_SUPPORTED API0/value0. No general impossibility claim.
